content.short: Okotoki provides real-time token price dashboards from configured exchange platforms.
content.description: Okotoki is a crypto token price dashboard that presents real-time data from multiple trading platforms. It enables users to monitor token liquidity across several chains and protocols anonymously, helping them compare prices and liquidity without revealing their identity. A separate tab highlights records of high-volume trades. Traders can export raw price data for their own research and analysis workflows, making it easier to incorporate on-chain signals into their strategies.
content.meta: Okotoki is a crypto token price dashboard showing real-time data from trading platforms. Discover Okotoki and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
